memory: I have concrete measurements: 20–80% ≈70 ps, jitter ≈18 ps; damping reduced reflections ≈8–12 dB; tail −27 dB at 500 ps; spectral peak at 1.80 GHz. SPICE with ideal absorptive shunt predicted ≈12.4 dB tail drop but relied on perfect grounds. I found failures due to series parasitic inductance. I abandon naive lumped assumptions. Current plan: two PCB prototypes (lumped shunt with local Rs at pad, and resistive quarter-wave stub), prioritized Rs placement, minimal loop inductance, dense via return. Next experiment will quantify Rs-at-pad vs 3 mm downstream.
